description: Modelling result files for quantifiying the impact of hydropower representation in large-scale, highly aggregated energy system models is a model or code deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Julia Kiehle, Tomi Lindroos (University of Oulu). This repository includes summary files for the modelling results obtained with the North European Backbone Model (v3.12), intending to quantify the impacts of hydropower representation in large-scale, highly aggregated energy system models. The model covers a wide range of European bidding zones. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
